name: rollcall_vasianvampire
about: Roll call: classname npc_VAsianVampire builds CNPC_VAsianVampire (factory 0x103602f0, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from sm_vamparena (AsianVamp) stands in the arena; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
